description: [Discovery Gateway] Explores the 3 Business Verticals of GEO360 (commercial_transit, luxury_vip, industrial_b2a) and transversal affiliate_2_0. Call without domain or domain='summary' for storefront; call with domain='transit', 'vip', 'b2a', or 'aff2' to enter that specific shop and retrieve its specialized tools.

compact.description: If true, returns condensed schema to preserve LLM context tokens.

domain.description: Vertical shop to explore: 'summary' (3+1 vitrina), 'transit' (10 mobility tools), 'vip' (6 luxury tools), 'b2a' (12 industrial clearing tools), 'aff2' (6 arbitrage tools).
